style: clean, minimal, no text at all — just the finished logo mark stamping in and drawing itself, then a single glow pulse and a hold
font: none — this version of the sting has no wordmark, tagline, or underline; it is the logo mark alone

asset_needs.treatment: recolored to site palette (ink bg, white A, amber V) — see customize.recolor

customize.major_revision: User supplied a finished, designer-made logo (/Users/ramrac/Downloads/Frame 1.svg) and asked to (1) use it as the one and only logo, replacing every prior in-house iteration, (2) recolor it to the site's exact palette, and (3) remove the wordmark/tagline/underline sequence entirely — the sting is now just this logo animating in, nothing else.
customize.shape_structure: 4 paths: a rounded-square/circle badge background (single subpath), an abstract 'A' shape (single subpath, the left/main glyph), and a 'V' checkmark-like swoosh made of 2 subpaths (a small tip + a long curling tail). A near-duplicate second background path in the original file (with an inner 'hole' subpath) was confirmed empirically to have zero visible effect (same-direction winding under nonzero fill-rule) and was dropped.
customize.recolor: Background badge: designer's #020202 -> site ink #18181B. 'A': designer's #F8F8F8 -> white #FFFFFF. 'V' (both subpaths): designer's #F8F8F8 -> site accent #A05708. This follows the same 'one letter neutral, one letter accent' convention used by every prior monogram iteration on this project.
customize.reveal_technique: Same proven technique as the old wordmark: each mark shape has an outline (stroke, fill:none) twin and a fill (solid) twin. getTotalLength()/stroke-dashoffset draws the outline like a pen, then a short crossfade settles it into the real solid fill. The badge itself is NOT drawn this way — it's a simple 'stamp' scale+fade (back.out overshoot) since it's a plain rounded shape, not a letterform worth tracing.
customize.background: pure white (#FFFFFF) full-bleed — the dark badge is a floating chip/seal on white, not a dark full-screen backdrop.

timing_beats_s.badge_stamp: 0.15–0.50 (scale 0.7->1 + fade, back.out(1.6) overshoot — a seal 'stamping' down)
timing_beats_s.glow_bloom: 1.75–2.30 (beat @1.75s grow, @1.95s fade start, single pulse, no repeat)

brief: The finished AV badge logo (user-supplied, recolored to the site's ink/white/amber palette) stamps into frame like a wax seal, then its 'A' draws itself on stroke-by-stroke and settles into solid white, then the 'V' swoosh draws in amber and settles, a single soft amber glow pulses once, and the mark holds still. No wordmark, no tagline, no underline — the whole sting is the logo alone, per an explicit request to strip everything else out of the start animation.
